scope: Proposed repository rules only; isolated Standard Firestore emulator, not deployed production configuration
summary: Clients can only read published scholarship records. All client creates, updates and deletes, drafts, reviewer logs and other collections are denied. Published records must contain only intentionally public reviewed fields; rules do not hide individual fields.
limitations: Not an audit of actual production rules or stored data
Admin SDK bypasses rules; trusted publication process still requires independent controls
Public published records are readable without identity by design; never publish private metadata
